Row.Text: +2 [icon:WAR_SUPPORT] War Support when in only one [icon:PLAYER_RELATIONSHIP_ALLIANCE] Alliance. When one of your Military Units defeats an enemy Unit, gain [icon:YIELD_DIPLOMACY] Influence equal to 50% of the defeated Unit's [icon:NAR_REW_COMBAT] Combat Strength. All basic Endeavors are automatically unlocked. Endeavors with Allies don’t count against the limit of having one Endeavor of a given type active at a time. Allies can support your Endeavors for free.
